## Problem

What user/operator problem does this change solve?

## Change

What changed? Focus on observable behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The intended behavior is described in verifiable terms.
- [ ] Authorization and invalid transitions are addressed where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated.

## Verification

List exact commands, results, and test level (static, unit, integration, or live E2E). Do not claim tests ran if they did not.

## Risk and rollback

What may regress, and how can this change be reverted safely?
